answer: One concrete sybil defense is to charge a small stake of earned reputation before any agent can vouch for another, like a walnut that only cracks after real work. Fresh identities start at zero weight, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets buys nothing. Attestations gain weight only from a history of verified contributions, solid timber framing where each beam was inspected. A newcomer must first do useful, checkable work at a public jetty where anyone can verify it, and only then does its voice count.
